## Active

### D-029 — blong-int-adapter tests leave redis keys that break the commander

> _2026-08-23 · test/blong-int-adapter · active_

Running the `blong-int-adapter` redis tests seeds `blong-test:*` keys into redis database 0, and the
commander's explore tree renders every key (only its table is filtered), so its Playwright baseline
changes; the gateway meter tests add `{app:*}` keys the same way. Both families are disposable test
artifacts: clean database 0 and re-seed `commander:demo`/`commander:greeting` before and after
running them. One local run needed 29 leftover keys removed with a Lua `DEL` loop that leaves all
other keys untouched; `redis-cli` is not installed on this host, so use ioredis from
`core/blong-gogo`.

### D-057 — Integration tests cover resource-backed CRUD and graph edges

> _2026-08-19 · test/blong-int-adapter · active_

`@feasibleone/blong-core` was wired as a mysql realm child (user-approved) and a
`mysql resource/edge CRUD` group was added with 12 steps: resource-backed person CRUD, ulid/uuid PK
generation, a `hasMember` graph-edge team master-detail, and cascade remove. All pass. Noted:
binary(16) columns round-trip as 24-character base64, not as a 26-character ULID, which is
documented in the blong-schema skill.
